newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed flat at 3.20 pct from parity.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed flat at 3.20 pct from parity.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1105 to the dollar, down from 3.1095 on Wednesday and at 1.8125 to the mark, down from 1.8100, the central bank said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 3.20 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, basically flat from Wednesday's 3.22 percent fix.
According to the floating parity rate, which changes along with intraday currency moves on world markets, the zloty was fixed at 3.22 percent from parity, against Wednesday's 3.21.
